name: Pikes Peak
realName: Pikes Peak International Hill Climb — the Race to the Clouds
creator: Bnuuy
notes: 12.42 miles from the start line at 9,390 ft to the summit at 14,115 ft (net climb 4,725 ft, average grade 7.2%). All 156 official turns are counted (40 tight, 76 medium, 40 fast — a reading of the road, not a survey); the corners are so dense that the engine shrinks its standard corner arcs to fit them. The gravel condition is the pre-2011 surface. Record: 7:57.148 (Dumas, VW I.D. R, 2018). Altitude is the summit.
